system.description:
• You protect the dead from those who would misuse them, and oppose unlawful undead wherever they appear. The morally lightest path — you use death magic to ensure the dead rest as they should.
  • Warden's Strike
  • An undead you did not create that you hit can't use its auras, drains or frightful presence until the end of its next turn, and undead you destroy can't rise again. Undead you did not create make their saves against your death magic with Disadvantage
  • When you destroy an undead creature, all undead you control within 30ft regain 1d6 HP
  • Deathwatch
  • Advantage on checks to identify, research, or communicate with undead
  • You always know whether a corpse has been subjected to necromantic magic and approximately when it was raised
